bugs.creator: Andre_Mikulec
bugs.summary: Surprise old R versions for Windows now only located at https://cran-archive.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old

comments.text:
Hi,

I do not know where to report this.  Therefore, I am reporting this here.  If I am reporting in the wrong place, please tell me the correct place to report or please refer me.

In the future (emphasis), when changing the physical locations of the old versions of R for Windows that would be moved from "https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/" to "https://cran-archive.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/", then please report this change somewhere publicly.  E.g. "What's New?" at this page (or a sub-page of) https://www.r-project.org/news.html .

The location of the old R versions for Windows have changed from "any version 4.0.0 or less" to "any version 4.2.0 or less" during late October 2026 or early November 2026 without an announcement. 

Old - seen OCT 22 2026
```
R 4.0.0 (April, 2020)
In the CRAN archives (https://cran-archive.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/):
R 3.6.3 (February, 2020)
```
at 
https://web.archive.org/web/20261022065611/https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/

New - seen NOV 07 2026
```
R 4.2.0 (April, 2022)
In the CRAN archives (https://cran-archive.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/):
R 4.1.3 (March, 2022)
```
at 
https://web.archive.org/web/20261107030245/https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/

This change surprised me. Thus, I could not know to change my builder job old R for Windows location.  Therefore, my "Embedded R" builder job failed:

https://ci.appveyor.com/project/AndreMikulec/plr/build/job/penn9uwfffvhtddq#L321
```
VERBOSE: GET https://cran.r-project.org/bin/windows/base/old/4.1.3/R-4.1.3-win.exe with 0-byte payload
curl : The remote server returned an error: (404) Not Found.
At line:26 char:3
+   curl -o "R-${env:rversion}-win.exe" -v "${env:rversionurl}"
+   ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

Again, would just appreciate a(n) future (emphasis) announcement.

Thanks,
Andre Mikulec

comments.text:
Thank you for the report! I think you'll need to contact someone from the [CRAN team], likely Dr. Uwe Ligges (since he's responsible for the Windows binary packages).

Since this problem is not in the base R source code, this bug report will have to be closed.

[CRAN team]: https://cran.r-project.org/CRAN_team.htm
